scripts.start:backend: cd server && source venv/bin/activate && python main.py
scripts.start:acestep: export PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 && cd ace-step && export MAX_CUDA_VRAM=12 && export ACESTEP_CONFIG_PATH=acestep-v15-turbo && uv run --no-sync acestep-api --port 8101 --init-llm --lm-model-path acestep-5Hz-lm-1.7B --quantization int8_weight_only
scripts.start:acestep-base: export PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 && cd ace-step && export MAX_CUDA_VRAM=12 && export ACESTEP_CONFIG_PATH=acestep-v15-base && uv run --no-sync acestep-api --port 8101 --init-llm --lm-model-path acestep-5Hz-lm-1.7B --quantization int8_weight_only
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others --names "BACKEND,ACESTEP,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "blue,magenta,green" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:acestep" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.dev:all-base: concurrently --kill-others --names "BACKEND,ACESTEP-BASE,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "blue,magenta,green" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:acestep-base" "npm run start:frontend"
